subject: general
question: What was the theme of the International Day of Democracy, 2025, celebrated in September 2025?

options.text: Achieving Gender Equality, Action by Action

solution:
The correct answer is __**Achieving Gender Equality, Action by Action**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **International Day of Democracy** is celebrated annually on **September 15** across the globe to promote and uphold the principles of **democracy**.
 
• For the year **2025**, the designated theme is **Achieving Gender Equality, Action by Action**, focusing on the critical role that **gender parity** plays in the sustainability of democratic institutions.
 
• The day was established by a resolution passed by the **United Nations General Assembly** in **2007**, with the aim of encouraging governments to strengthen their **national programs** devoted to the promotion and consolidation of democracy.
 
• The theme **Achieving Gender Equality, Action by Action** highlights that a **democracy** is truly representative only when **women** have equal access to **political leadership** and decision-making processes. ***Hence, the correct answer is option 4.***
 
• This theme emphasizes **concrete actions** and **policy reforms** rather than just rhetoric, aiming to eliminate the **systemic barriers** that prevent **marginalized genders** from participating in **civic life**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Historical Context:**
 
 
• The idea for the day originated from the **Inter-Parliamentary Union (IPU)**, which adopted the **Universal Declaration on Democracy** in **September 1997**.
 
• This declaration affirmed that **democracy** is an **international standard** and a fundamental right for all citizens of the world.
 
 
 
• **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs):**
 
 
• The **2025 theme** is closely linked to **SDG 5** (**Gender Equality**) and **SDG 16** (**Peace, Justice, and Strong Institutions**).
 
• The **United Nations** recognizes that **inclusive governance** is essential for achieving the **2030 Agenda** for Sustainable Development.
 
 
 
• **Legal Foundations:**
 
 
• The principles of **democracy** are enshrined in the **Universal Declaration of Human Rights**, specifically under **Article 21**, which states that the **will of the people** shall be the basis of the authority of government.
 
• This is expressed through **periodic and genuine elections** by universal and **equal suffrage**.
 
 
 
• **Global Participation:**
 
 
• Various **non-governmental organizations (NGOs)**, **parliaments**, and **civil society** groups hold events on **September 15** to discuss **transparency**, **accountability**, and **human rights**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Gender and Democracy:** Research by the **UN Women** and the **IPU** consistently shows that countries with higher **female representation** in **legislatures** tend to pass more laws related to **social welfare**, **education**, and **healthcare**.
 
• **Challenges in 2025:** The theme addresses the **global decline** in democratic freedoms in some regions and the **gender-based violence** that often targets women in **public office**.
 
• **Implementation:** **"Action by Action"** refers to localized efforts such as **legislative quotas**, **funding for women candidates**, and **combating online harassment** to ensure a safe **democratic space** for all.
 
• **Institutional Role:** The **United Nations Department of Global Communications** works alongside the **IPU** to disseminate educational materials about the **rule of law** and **voter education** on this day.
